title: Spatial Contract v1 -- Capture Quality Result
$comment: Stage D1 frozen contract, version-stamped and renamed from scripts/drawn_response/schemas/capture_quality_record.schema.json to match the non-negotiable-architecture name 'capture_quality_result'. Structurally unchanged: still defined by TASK-0011_PHASE_1_EXECUTION_SPEC.md sections 5/7.1. This record is the first of the five non-negotiable separate record types (Phase D prompt 'Non-negotiable architecture'): it describes the IMAGE, never the student's graph correctness ('Missing axis labels on a clear photograph are a scoring observation, not a capture failure'). It never awards points and is not itself a release control -- CAPTURE_DISPOSITION only gates whether the image proceeds to observation/decision at all.

CAPTURE_DISPOSITION.description: RETAKE only when recapture can plausibly fix the defect; otherwise HUMAN_REVIEW.
